credit-registration-link-step-enrol: Enrol on the course, as described below.
credit-registration-link-step-open: Open the link while you are logged in to this account. That links your student number, and we register your credits.
credit-registration-linking-email-send-f: We could not send the confirmation link to your email address in Sisu. Contact support to get your student number linked.
credit-registration-linking-email-sent: We sent a confirmation link to your email address in Sisu ({{email}}) on {{date}}.
credit-registration-linking-email-short-: Confirmation link could not be sent
credit-registration-module-paused-explan: Registration for {{module}} is paused. Nothing is sent to Sisu until support resumes it.
credit-registration-no-enrolment-link-av: We do not have a direct link to this course's enrolment page right now. Enrol at the Open University. Once we can see your enrolment, we register your credits automatically.
credit-registration-open-university-enro: Credits for this course are registered through the Open University of the University of Helsinki. Enrol there, and we register your credits automatically once we can see your enrolment. Enrolling requires strong identification. See the <openUniversityInfoLink>Open University enrolment page</openUniversityInfoLink> for details.
credit-registration-owner-heading-awaiti: Waiting for a check, not a new send
credit-registration-owner-heading-suppor: Support has to look into it
credit-registration-recent-actions-hint: Shows what colleagues and support have already done, so nobody sends the same rows again.
credit-registration-refusal-already-subm: This attempt has already been sent to Sisu, and Sisu has not given its final answer yet. Sending it again could register the credits twice.
credit-registration-refusal-already-succ: The credits are already in Sisu, so there is nothing to send again.
credit-registration-refusal-not-failed-p: Only a failed registration can be sent again here. This one is still in progress, already finished, or waiting on support.
credit-registration-refusal-submission-p: Sisu is still processing the earlier submission and may still record it. Sending it again now could register the credits twice. Wait until it is confirmed.
credit-registration-refusal-submission-u: We do not know whether Sisu recorded this submission, so it cannot be sent again. Support has to check Sisu and resolve it.
credit-registration-refusal-superseded: A later attempt has replaced this one. Act on the later attempt instead.
credit-registration-refusal-unknown: The server refused this for an unknown reason. Ask support before you act.
credit-registration-registered-email-sen: We could not send you a confirmation email. Your credits are registered anyway.
We emailed you a confirmation on {{date}}.
credit-registration-resend-address-they-: For most students, this email is the only way to link their student number. It goes to their email address in Sisu, which is usually not the address they use here. When you tell them it is on its way, say which mailbox to check.
credit-registration-resend-already-linke: This student number is already linked to an account, so no confirmation link is needed.
credit-registration-resend-already-maile: We have already emailed every address Sisu holds for this student on this course.
credit-registration-resend-mails-so-far: {{sent}} of at most {{max}} confirmation emails sent for this course.
credit-registration-resend-no-address: Sisu holds no email address for this student.
credit-registration-resend-no-student-nu: We do not know this student's student number. Ask them for it and enter it above.
credit-registration-resend-not-on-roster: Sisu does not list this student on this course.
credit-registration-resend-queued: The confirmation link is queued and will be sent from our system shortly.
credit-registration-resend-refused-by-ra: We emailed this student recently, or they have had every email this course allows. Ask support if it is urgent.
credit-registration-resend-registry-unav: We could not reach Sisu, so nothing was sent. Try again later.
credit-registration-resend-unknown-outco: We do not recognise this result. Do not assume the email was sent. Ask support to check the audit log.
credit-registration-retry-blocked-by-pau: Nothing can be sent while registration is paused. Only support can resume it.
credit-registration-retry-retried: The registration is back in the queue and will be sent again.
credit-registration-student-number-after: Once your student number is linked, we register your credits.
credit-registration-student-number-step-: Open the confirmation link we emailed to {{email}} on {{date}}.
Open it while you are logged in to this account.
credit-registration-teacher-enrolment-re: We will check the student's enrolment again within a few minutes.
credit-registration-teacher-error-course: Sisu does not recognise the course code set for this module. Correct the code in the module settings.
Credits on this course cannot be registered automatically. Support has to raise this with the University.
credit-registration-teacher-error-enrolm: Sisu shows this student's enrolment as not accepted. The student has to contact the Open University about it.
Sisu has no enrolment for this student on this course. The student has to enrol before the credits can be registered.
credit-registration-teacher-error-grade-: Sisu did not accept the grading scale this course uses there. Support has to look into it.
credit-registration-teacher-error-invali: Sisu did not accept the number of credits set for this module. Correct the credits in the module settings.
This grade does not exist on the grading scale Sisu uses for this course. Support has to look into it.
credit-registration-teacher-error-malfor: Sisu did not accept the data we sent. Support has to fix it. Sending it again unchanged does not help.
credit-registration-teacher-error-misreg: The credits were registered in Sisu but are no longer there. Support is finding out why.
credit-registration-teacher-error-missin: This module has no number of credits set, so nothing can be registered for it. Set the credits in the module settings.
This module has no University course code, so nothing can be registered for it. Set the code in the module settings.
credit-registration-teacher-error-no-gra: This module's grades do not fit the grading scale Sisu uses for this course, for example pass/fail here but 0–5 in Sisu. Support has to look into it.
credit-registration-teacher-error-not-re: The credits did not reach Sisu. They are sent again automatically.
credit-registration-teacher-error-person: Sisu has no student with this number. The student should check the number they linked. If it is right, support has to look into it.
credit-registration-teacher-error-retry-: We tried for a week and then stopped. Sending it again starts another week of attempts.
credit-registration-teacher-error-servic: We could not reach Sisu at the time. Sending it again is worth trying.
credit-registration-teacher-error-sisu-t: Sisu did not answer in time, so we do not know yet whether the credits were registered. Support checks Sisu before anything is sent again.
credit-registration-teacher-error-sisu-v: Sisu did not accept the registration and did not say why. Support has to look at what was sent.
credit-registration-teacher-error-study-: This student has no valid study right for this course in Sisu. The student has to enrol at the Open University.
credit-registration-teacher-error-transp: We could not reach Sisu at the time. Sending it again is worth trying.
credit-registration-teacher-error-unauth: Sisu did not accept our credentials. Support has to renew them. Nothing is registered until they do.
credit-registration-teacher-error-unexpe: We could not read Sisu's answer. Sending it again is worth trying.
credit-registration-teacher-error-unknow: This failure has no reason we recognise. Support has to look into it.
credit-registration-teacher-explanation-: These credits could not be registered.
We are checking Sisu for the student's enrolment on this course. This usually takes a few minutes.
We cannot find an enrolment for this student on this course in Sisu yet. We check regularly and register the credits once we can see it.
The student has not linked a student number yet. The confirmation link goes to their email address in Sisu.
The student has no student number linked. Account linking is switched off, so no confirmation link is sent. Ask support to link the number by hand.
These credits are not being registered.
The credits are registered in Sisu.
The credits are being registered. This usually takes a few minutes.
This status is not one this page knows.
The student has not completed this module yet. Nothing is registered before they do.
Sisu does not accept this module's course code yet, so nothing is registered until the code is fixed.
The credits have been sent to Sisu. Sisu usually confirms them within a few days.
credit-registration-teacher-linking-emai: Confirmation link queued for {{address}}, not sent from our system yet.
Sending the confirmation link to {{address}} failed once. We are trying again.
Sending the confirmation link to {{address}} failed. Ask support to send it again.
Confirmation link sent from our system to {{address}} on {{date}}.
credit-registration-teacher-notification: Queued, not sent from our system yet.
Sending failed once. We are trying again.
Sending failed, so the student did not get this email.
credit-registration-unlinked-emails-fail: We could not send the confirmation email to {{count}} of them. Support has been told.
We could not send the confirmation email to {{count}} of them. Support has been told.
credit-registration-unlinked-enrolled-ex: {{count}} enrolled student on this course has not linked a student number yet. Their credits cannot be registered until they do, whether or not they have completed anything.
{{count}} enrolled students on this course have not linked a student number yet. Their credits cannot be registered until they do, whether or not they have completed anything.
credit-registration-waiting-for-enrolmen: We are looking for your enrolment in the background. As soon as we can see it, we register your credits automatically. If you have enrolled, you do not need to do anything else.
We are looking for your enrolment
We check regularly, often at first and then less often. You do not need to keep this page open.
credit-registration-with-support-explana: Support is handling these. They are also counted in the statuses next to them.
credit-registration-you-told-us-you-enro: You told us you enrolled at the Open University on {{date}}.
You told us you enrolled through Sisu on {{date}}.
description-resend-linking-email-student: Read it off the student's card if we do not have it.
heading-credit-registration-config-probl: This module cannot register credits with its current settings.
{{module}} cannot register credits with its current settings.
student-number-confirmed-by-emailed-link: Confirmation link sent to your email address in Sisu
student-number-credits-registered-under-: Credits from your courses are registered under this student number.
student-number-no-registering-courses: None of your current courses registers credits in Sisu automatically. We keep the number for courses that do.
student-number-not-linked: No student number is linked to this account yet.
student-number-staff-links-it: Support links your student number to this account. You do not need to do anything.
student-number-step-link-arrives-by-emai: Once we can see your enrolment, we email a confirmation link to your email address in Sisu. This may not be the address you use here.
student-number-summary-linked: Your credits are registered under student number <number>{{studentNumber}}</number>.
student-number-summary-not-linked: No student number is linked yet. Once we can see your enrolment on a course, we email you a confirmation link.
student-number-summary-not-linked-staff-: No student number is linked yet. Support links it for you.
student-number-wrong-number-ask-staff: If this is not your student number, contact support to have it corrected.
support-mail-line-link-used-by-someone-e: Someone else appears to have used my student number confirmation link.
support-mail-line-need-a-new-confirmatio: I need a new confirmation link for my student number.
support-mail-line-number-linked-to-anoth: My student number is linked to another account and I need it moved to this one.
